ADDSUB_IMMEDIATE.encoding: 0000 0110 ss mmm rrr for ADDI and 0000 0100 ss mmm rrr for SUBI; sizes 00/01/10 are byte/word/long and the immediate precedes any destination-EA extension
ADDSUB_IMMEDIATE.operation: add or subtract the sized immediate and replace the sized data-alterable destination; preserve the unselected upper Dn bits
memory_sequence: fetch one byte/word or two long immediate words
exceptions: 212 reserved size or non-data-alterable words across the two 256-word encoding planes
extension/read/write fault suppresses destination, address-register, flags and PC commit
coverage_domains: all legal and illegal effective addresses
model_limits: M00 data-alterable destination table and M00 group-0 fault frames

LOGICAL_IMMEDIATE.encoding: 0000 ooo0 ss mmm rrr, with ooo selecting ORI/ANDI/EORI; exact low-byte values 0x3c and 0x7c are the separately decoded CCR/SR forms
LOGICAL_IMMEDIATE.operation: OR, AND or exclusive-OR the sized immediate with a data-alterable destination and replace that sized destination
exceptions: the six exact CCR/SR words decode through LOGICAL_IMMEDIATE_SR
312 remaining non-generic words in the three 256-word planes are illegal on M00
extension/read/write fault suppresses all candidate architectural state
coverage_domains: all legal and illegal effective addresses
model_limits: M00 data-alterable destination table and M00 group-0 fault frames

LOGICAL_IMMEDIATE_SR.encoding: exact opcodes 0x003c/0x007c, 0x023c/0x027c and 0x0a3c/0x0a7c select ORI/ANDI/EORI to CCR/SR
LOGICAL_IMMEDIATE_SR.operation: apply the selected logical operation to the implemented CCR bits or to the complete status register
memory_sequence: fetch exactly one immediate extension word
exceptions: SR forms are supervisor-only and take privilege vector 8 at the faulting instruction PC in user mode
extension fetch bus/address fault uses the M00 group-0 program-space frame
model_limits: implemented M00 SR/CCR bits

CMP_IMMEDIATE.encoding: 0000 1100 ss mmm rrr, sizes 00/01/10 are byte/word/long and the immediate precedes any destination-EA extension
CMP_IMMEDIATE.operation: subtract the immediate from the sized destination only to set condition codes; never write the comparison result
memory_sequence: memory forms perform exactly one ordered read
address/flags/PC commit after a successful read
exceptions: 106 size/addressing holes are illegal in the 256-word plane
M00 excludes An direct, PC-relative and immediate destinations
extension or operand-read fault suppresses flags and address-register commit
coverage_domains: all legal and illegal effective addresses
model_limits: PC-relative CMPI begins on later family members, not M00

ADDQ_SUBQ.encoding: 0101 qqq o ss mmm rrr, where qqq zero denotes eight, o selects ADDQ/SUBQ and sizes 00/01/10 are byte/word/long; size 11 belongs to Scc/DBcc
ADDQ_SUBQ.operation: add or subtract the decoded value one through eight; sized data destinations preserve unselected Dn bits, while An always uses all 32 bits regardless of encoded word/long size

flags.X: data destination carry/borrow; preserved for An
flags.N: sized data result sign; preserved for An
flags.Z: sized data result zero; preserved for An
flags.V: signed data overflow; preserved for An
flags.C: data destination carry/borrow; preserved for An

exceptions: 416 byte/word/long EA combinations are illegal
size 11 decodes as Scc/DBcc rather than ADDQ/SUBQ
extension/read/write fault suppresses destination, address-register, flags and PC commit
coverage_domains: all legal and illegal effective addresses
model_limits: M00 alterable destinations and M00 group-0 fault frames

ADD_EA_DN.encoding: 1101 DDD 0ss mmm rrr, with sizes 00/01/10 selecting byte/word/long; the direction-clear ADD plane is distinct from ADDA and ADDX
ADD_EA_DN.operation: add the sized source EA to Dn and replace only the selected byte/word/long portion of Dn
memory_sequence: perform one ordered source read for a memory EA
commit the sized Dn result, source address side effect, flags and PC only after a successful read
exceptions: 136 source-EA/size holes are illegal in the 1536-word direction-clear ADD plane
byte An direct is illegal
extension or operand-read fault suppresses Dn, source-address, flags and PC commit
coverage_domains: all legal and illegal source EAs
model_limits: M00 source-EA table and M00 group-0 fault frames

ADDSUB_ADDRESS.encoding: operation nibble d/9, destination AAA, opmode 011/111 and source EA select ADDA/SUBA word/long
ADDSUB_ADDRESS.operation: sign-extend a word source or use a long source, then add it to or subtract it from all 32 bits of the destination address register
memory_sequence: perform one ordered source read for a memory EA
apply the source-EA address side effect
commit the complete 32-bit destination An and PC after a successful read
exceptions: each 1024-word family plane contains 976 legal words and 48 mode-7 holes
first/second extension or operand-read fault suppresses destination, source-address and PC commit
coverage_domains: all legal and illegal source EAs
model_limits: M00 effective-address side effects and group-0 fault frames

CMPA.encoding: 1011 AAA 011/111 mmm rrr selects CMPA word/long with an address-register destination and arbitrary M00 source EA
CMPA.operation: sign-extend a word source or use a long source, subtract it from all 32 bits of An only to set condition codes, and never store the arithmetic result
memory_sequence: perform one ordered source read for a memory EA
commit only source-EA side effect, NZVC and PC after a successful read
exceptions: the 1024-word CMPA plane contains 976 legal words and 48 mode-7 holes
first/second extension or operand-read fault suppresses source-address, flags and PC commit
coverage_domains: all legal and illegal source EAs
model_limits: M00 effective-address side effects and group-0 fault frames

BINARY_EA_DN.encoding: operation nibble 8/9/b/c, DDD, direction bit 0, size 00/01/10 and source EA; these planes select OR/SUB/CMP/AND respectively
BINARY_EA_DN.operation: OR, subtract, compare or AND the sized source EA with Dn; CMP discards its arithmetic result

flags.V: SUB/CMP signed overflow; cleared by AND/OR

memory_sequence: perform one ordered source read for a memory EA
commit Dn when applicable, source-address side effect, flags and PC only after a successful read
exceptions: 936 holes exist across the five ADD/SUB/CMP/AND/OR direction-clear planes when ADD_EA_DN is included
AND/OR reject An at every size; SUB/CMP reject byte An
extension or operand-read fault suppresses every candidate architectural commit
coverage_domains: all legal and illegal source EAs
model_limits: M00 source-EA tables and M00 group-0 fault frames

BINARY_DN_EA.encoding: operation nibble 8/9/b/c/d, source DDD, direction bit 1, size 00/01/10 and destination EA; generic words select OR/SUB/EOR/AND/ADD
BINARY_DN_EA.operation: apply the selected sized binary operation from Dn to a memory-alterable destination, or EOR from Dn to a data-alterable destination

flags.V: ADD/SUB signed overflow; cleared by logical operations
flags.C: ADD carry or SUB borrow; cleared by logical operations

memory_sequence: commit destination address side effect, flags and PC only after a successful write
exceptions: the five 1536-word raw planes contain 5232 generic words, 1408 architecturally distinct overlap words and 1040 illegal holes
overlaps are ADDX/SUBX register and memory, ABCD/SBCD, EXG and CMPM and must retain decoder priority
extension, operand-read or operand-write fault suppresses every uncompleted architectural commit
coverage_domains: all legal and illegal destination EAs
model_limits: M00 memory-alterable/data-alterable tables and M00 group-0 fault frames

MUL.encoding: 1100 DDD s11 mmm rrr, where s selects unsigned/signed word multiplication and DDD selects the data-register destination
MUL.operation: multiply the low word of Dn by the word source as either two unsigned or two signed operands and replace all 32 bits of Dn with the product

flags.V: cleared for the M00 word form

memory_sequence: perform exactly one ordered word read for a memory source
commit the 32-bit Dn result, source-address side effect, flags and PC after a successful read
exceptions: each 512-word signed/unsigned plane contains 424 legal words and 88 An/mode-7 holes
first/second extension or operand-read fault suppresses destination, source-address, flags and PC commit
coverage_domains: all legal and illegal source EAs
model_limits: M00 word form; later-family long multiply is a separate contract

DIV.encoding: 1000 DDD s11 mmm rrr, where s selects unsigned/signed word division and DDD supplies the 32-bit dividend/destination
sizes: long dividend divided by word source to word remainder and quotient
DIV.operation: divide Dn by the signed or unsigned word source; on success store the 16-bit remainder in Dn[31:16] and quotient in Dn[15:0], with a signed remainder having the dividend sign

flags.V: quotient overflow; undefined on zero divisor

memory_sequence: perform exactly one ordered word read for a memory source
commit Dn only for a representable quotient; commit defined flags and source-address side effect after completion
exceptions: each 512-word signed/unsigned plane contains 424 legal words and 88 An/mode-7 holes
zero divisor takes vector 5 and stacks the following PC without changing Dn; X is preserved and C is cleared while N/Z/V are undefined
unsigned quotient above 65535 or signed quotient outside -32768..32767 sets V, clears C and preserves Dn; N/Z are undefined
first/second extension or operand-read fault suppresses destination, source-address, flags and PC commit
coverage_domains: all legal and illegal source EAs
model_limits: M00 word form; N/Z on overflow and N/Z/V on divide by zero are preserved deterministically but remain outside the architectural contract

ADDX_SUBX_REGISTER.encoding: ADDX/SUBX register forms, Rx bit clear, sizes 00/01/10; six patterns with two three-bit Dn fields
ADDX_SUBX_REGISTER.operation: destination plus/minus source plus extend; sized Dn write, cumulative zero

flags.Z: old Z and sized result zero

exceptions: illegal instruction for reserved size or non-register encoding
model_limits: MC68000 register form only; memory predecrement is audited separately

ADDX_SUBX_MEMORY.encoding: ADDX/SUBX predecrement-memory forms, Rx bit set, sizes 00/01/10; six patterns with independently encoded Ax/Ay fields
ADDX_SUBX_MEMORY.operation: predecrement and read the source, independently predecrement and read the destination, add or subtract with X, then store the sized result at the destination; same-An operands apply both decrements in sequence

flags.Z: old Z and sized result zero

memory_sequence: publish both address updates, flags and PC only after the final successful response
exceptions: a source-read, destination-read or destination-write bus error builds the seven-word M00 diagnostic frame with the exact failed address and direction
an incomplete operation publishes no address-register, memory, CCR or PC candidate state
A7 uses a two-byte step for byte operands
model_limits: MC68000 group-0 frames do not contain restart state; MX68K deterministically response-gates incomplete architectural updates, while future restartable profiles may retain private replay checkpoints

ABCD_SBCD.encoding: ABCD/SBCD register or predecrement-memory byte forms selected by R/M, with independently encoded source and destination registers
ABCD_SBCD.operation: perform packed-BCD destination plus/minus source plus the decimal carry/borrow represented by X, storing only the destination byte

flags.Z: old Z and result byte zero

memory_sequence: for memory form, ordered source read
publish both predecrements, flags and PC only after the final successful response
exceptions: all valid packed-BCD source/destination pairs and both X inputs have independent arithmetic coverage
each of the three memory accesses has an injected group-0 read/write fault case
same-An applies two predecrements and A7 decrements by two
model_limits: N and V are architecturally undefined
MC68000 group-0 frames are diagnostic rather than restartable; incomplete MX68K state is response-gated deterministically

CMPM.encoding: 1011 Ax 1 size 001 Ay; size 00/01/10 is byte/word/long; the size-like value 11 belongs to CMPA.L An,Ax
CMPM.operation: read source first, read destination second, compute sized destination minus source, update condition codes without storing the arithmetic result
exceptions: source bus/address fault prevents both postincrements and flags commit
destination bus/address fault preserves the completed source checkpoint but prevents destination postincrement and flags commit
the 64 words with bits 7:6 equal to 11 decode as CMPA.L with address-register source, not as CMPM
model_limits: MC68000 group-0 frames are not restartable; completed operand reads define the deterministic postincrement checkpoints

DBCC.encoding: 0101 cccc 11001 rrr followed by signed 16-bit displacement
DBCC.operation: if condition true continue; otherwise decrement Dn low word and branch unless result is minus one
exceptions: extension fetch bus/address fault at the extension PC
model_limits: M00 signed 16-bit displacement

EXG.encoding: three opmodes select Dn-Dn, An-An, or Dn-An; two three-bit register fields
EXG.operation: simultaneously exchange the complete 32-bit register values
exceptions: none for a legal encoding
model_limits: M00 register forms

EXT.encoding: 0100100010 000 rrr for EXT.W and 0100100011 000 rrr for EXT.L
EXT.operation: sign extend the sized low part while preserving the untouched upper half for EXT.W
exceptions: illegal instruction for non-EXT encodings
model_limits: EXTB is not part of M00

exceptions: vector 4 with faulting instruction PC
model_limits: architected ILLEGAL opcode only; reserved encodings are classified separately

MOVEQ.operation: sign extend the embedded byte and replace all 32 bits of Dn
exceptions: bit 8 set is not MOVEQ and must decode independently

MOVE_USP.encoding: 010011100110 d rrr, with direction bit selecting USP to/from An
MOVE_USP.operation: copy the complete 32-bit stack pointer value in the selected direction
exceptions: privilege violation vector 8 at the faulting PC in user mode
model_limits: supervisor-only M00 behavior

CLR.encoding: 01000010 ss mmm rrr with sizes 00/01/10 and an M00 data-alterable EA
CLR.operation: replace the sized destination with zero while preserving unselected Dn bits
memory_sequence: on M68000/M68008 read the memory destination
exceptions: illegal instruction for reserved size or non-data-alterable EA
extension/read/write fault suppresses destination, address-register and flags commit
coverage_domains: all legal and illegal effective addresses
model_limits: M00/M08 memory read-before-clear behavior; later-family timing is a separate profile contract

NEG.encoding: 01000100 ss mmm rrr with sizes 00/01/10 and an M00 data-alterable EA
NEG.operation: subtract the sized destination from zero and write the sized result

flags.V: set only for the most-negative operand

exceptions: illegal instruction for reserved size or non-data-alterable EA
extension/read/write fault suppresses destination, address-register and flags commit
coverage_domains: all legal and illegal effective addresses
model_limits: M00 data-alterable forms

NOT.encoding: 01000110 ss mmm rrr with sizes 00/01/10 and an M00 data-alterable EA
NOT.operation: ones-complement the sized destination and preserve unselected Dn bits
exceptions: illegal instruction for reserved size or non-data-alterable EA
extension/read/write fault suppresses destination, address-register and flags commit
coverage_domains: all legal and illegal effective addresses
model_limits: M00 data-alterable forms

SCC.encoding: 0101 cccc 11 mmm rrr with one of 16 conditions and an M00 byte data-alterable EA; mode 001 is the distinct DBcc format
SCC.operation: evaluate the selected condition over the current NZVC state and store 0xff for true or 0x00 for false; preserve unselected Dn bits
memory_sequence: on M68000/M68008 read the byte destination
exceptions: 96 mode-7 EA holes are illegal
128 mode-1 words decode as DBcc rather than Scc
extension/read/write fault suppresses destination, address-register and PC commit
coverage_domains: all legal and illegal effective addresses
model_limits: M00/M08 memory read-before-write behavior; later-family timing is a separate profile contract

NEGX.encoding: 01000000 ss mmm rrr with sizes 00/01/10 and data-alterable EA
NEGX.operation: zero minus destination minus X, sized write, cumulative zero

flags.Z: old Z and sized result zero

memory_sequence: memory form reads destination before its ordered write
exceptions: extension or data access fault at the documented failing access
illegal instruction for reserved size or EA
model_limits: M00 data-alterable forms

NOP.operation: advance to the next instruction after older bus activity is complete
exceptions: normal trace and interrupt recognition at the legal boundary
model_limits: in-order M00 synchronization behavior

RESET.operation: assert external reset for 124 M00 clocks without changing CPU registers
exceptions: privilege violation vector 8 at the faulting PC in user mode
model_limits: core boundary models the RESET output; peripheral reset policy is SoC integration

TAS.encoding: 0100101011 mmm rrr with data-alterable byte EA
TAS.operation: set N/Z from the original byte, clear V/C, then set destination bit 7 indivisibly for memory
memory_sequence: one indivisible atomic read-modify-write returning the original byte
exceptions: extension or write-classified data fault with no premature address update
illegal instruction for non-data-alterable EA
model_limits: M00 TAS; later CAS/CAS2 use separate contracts

STOP.encoding: exact opcode 0x4e72 followed by one SR immediate word
STOP.operation: load the complete SR, advance PC, and stop fetch until an accepted interrupt or reset
exceptions: privilege violation vector 8 in user mode
extension fetch fault
trace exception before stopped state becomes externally persistent
model_limits: M00 stop state

exceptions: nonmatching encodings decode according to their own family

TEST.encoding: 01001010 ss mmm rrr with sizes 00/01/10 and an M00 data-alterable EA; size 11 belongs to TAS/reserved encodings
TEST.operation: read the sized operand without modifying it and set condition codes from comparison with zero
memory_sequence: memory forms perform exactly one ordered read
postincrement or predecrement and flags commit only after a successful response
exceptions: address-register direct, PC-relative, immediate, reserved EAs and size 11 are not TST on M00
extension or operand read fault suppresses flags and address-register commit
coverage_domains: all legal and illegal effective addresses
model_limits: M00 excludes the An-direct and PC-relative forms added by later family members

SHIFT_REGISTER.encoding: 1110 ccc d ss i kk rrr, where d selects direction, ss is byte/word/long, i selects immediate/register count, kk selects AS/LS/ROX/RO and rrr is Dn
SHIFT_REGISTER.operation: shift or rotate the sized low part of Dn while preserving the unselected upper bits; immediate zero encodes eight and a register count uses its low six bits

flags.X: last shifted bit for AS/LS/ROX; preserved for RO and effective count zero
flags.V: ASL sign change at any step; otherwise cleared
flags.C: last shifted bit; effective zero clears C except ROX copies X

exceptions: size field 11 belongs to the separately decoded memory-shift subspace rather than a register operation
model_limits: M00 six-bit register count and immediate range one through eight

SHIFT_MEMORY.encoding: 1110 0oo d 11 mmm rrr, where oo selects AS/LS/ROX/RO and d selects right/left
effective_addresses: memory alterable: (An), (An)+, -(An), d16(An), d8(An,Xn), absolute word, absolute long
SHIFT_MEMORY.operation: read a word, shift or rotate exactly one bit, then write the word result to the same effective address

flags.X: last bit for AS/LS/ROX; preserved for RO
flags.C: last bit shifted or rotated out

exceptions: illegal instruction for every non-memory-alterable EA
read/write bus fault and odd-address error use M00 group-0 handling
model_limits: M00 word-only, fixed count one

TRAP.operation: take the selected synchronous trap after completing instruction decode
exceptions: vector 32+n with following PC in the frame
model_limits: M00 short frame

TRAPV.operation: take vector 7 when V is set; otherwise continue normally
memory_sequence: when taken, push six-byte M00 group-1/2 frame and read vector 7
exceptions: vector 7 with following PC when V is set
model_limits: M00 short frame
